title: 第二十一章 炸血库第二十二章 堕落月仆
content_zh:
孙六跑进巷子，掂了掂还热乎的钱袋，脸上露出得色。
果然，爷的眼光跟手艺，还是没问题！
即便带伤出场，依旧收获颇丰，昨天那就是一场事故。
秦家大少两次蛋碎，彻底没救的事情，今日已经传开，孙六菊花数紧之余忍不住生出一个念头……这事，该不会跟昨天那小子有关吧？
突然觉得背后有点冷，孙六缩了缩脖子，肯定是他想多了，那小子顶多就是有点厉害，欺负他还行，哪能掀起这般动静。
“收获不少啊？”一道声音在身后响起。
孙六盯着掌心白花花的银子，随手把钱袋丢进水沟，下意识道：“还凑合……”
嗖——
他撒腿就跑，头都没回。
啪——
一块石子击中小腿，孙六惨叫一声扑街，转身拼命磕头，“大爷饶命啊！我上有八十老老母，下有嗷嗷待哺儿女，这是我第一次做啊！”
脚步走近，戏谑声响起，“昨天，你似乎也是这么说的。”
哭喊戛然而止，孙六摸了一把鼻涕泪，看清了眼前之人，顿时一副吃了屎的表情。
“大爷……是……是您啊……呃……小人刚捡了个钱袋，这些银子就当是……孝敬给您了。”
罗冠不说话。
“咳……我给您放这儿……那，小人就继续听您昨天的话……滚了啊……”孙六趴在地上，把自己缩成一个球。
罗冠淡淡道：“秦家的事，你听说了吧？哦，看表情是知道，如果不想变得跟秦大少一样，就乖乖帮我办点事。”
孙六快吓哭了，这一句话里透露出的信息，实在是太恐怖，秦家大少居然真是他废的！知道这种要命的事，他还能有好下场？当即面无血色，抽搐着眼看就要过去。
罗冠冷笑，“你要敢装晕，我就让你一睡不起！”
孙六“嗖”爬起来，哭丧着脸，“爷……不，亲爹，您到底想干什么？我就是个混码头的小瘪三，您把我当个屁放了成吗？”

罗冠淡淡道：“把事做好，你的命就还是你的。”
孙六脸色阴晴不定，猛地咬牙，“好，我听您的！”
罗冠微微一笑，“你知道，城里哪能买到火药吧？”
孙六这种混迹在社会底层的渣滓，各种门道都有接触，天黑前在一片低矮的贫民窟里，罗冠亲眼看到一个躺在床上，浑身臭气熏天生满烂疮的老头，嘟囔着从床下拉出一个木箱。
“五百两黄金，半个子都不能少！”
火药早就出现了，但配方一直被朝廷掌握，严禁流入民间，一旦发现立刻收缴、重罚！所以，除了战争以外，基本只能在矿场见到，这个隐秘组织居然能拿出这么多，可见很有门道。
罗冠交钱，提着箱子从屋里出来，能清晰感觉到，周边一些贪婪、阴狠的眼神。
孙六战战兢兢，紧跟在罗冠身后，一通七拐八折后，才从这片贫民窟走了出来，长出一口气衣服已被冷汗浸透。
“大爷，事情办好了，那我走？”
罗冠淡淡道：“还有件事，告诉我黑石、东海两家的血库，分别在哪？
”您这一手提着炸药，一边用平静的语气问这种事，我压力真的很大！
孙六喉结上下滚动，艰难的咽了口吐沫，说出两个地址。
嘭——
他眼前一黑，被打昏过去。
罗冠提起孙六丢进角落里，等这家伙醒来，他应该已经离开山河城。
提着木箱，罗冠从容迈入长街，消失在滚滚人流中。
……
虽说山河城中，地位、份量足够的人都知道，黑石、东海两个竞争凶兽血的对头商会，实际上都是秦家的产业，可该做的面子工程还得有，要给爱财的城主大人，留一块过得去的遮羞布，所以两家商会的血库，一个城东一个城西。
今夜密云交织，空气有些潮湿，似乎是要下雨了，月亮、繁星皆被遮掩，伸手不见五指。
西城。

黑石商会血库，守卫森严！
“都打起精神来，守好各自的岗位，一只苍蝇扇动了翅膀，也得把它给找出来！”
一名小头目在黑夜中低喝，他不知道什么原因，但今夜血库中突然来了许多高手，虽说上面吩咐一切如旧，可他还是忍不住紧张。
因为少爷的事，家主今天已杖毙了七八人，小头目可不希望，自己成为下一个。
突然，一阵风刮过，吹动枝叶沙沙作响，小头目心中一惊，猛地转身却什么都没看到。
content_en:
Sun Liu ran into the alley and weighed the still warm money bag with a look of joy on his face.
Sure enough, my vision and craftsmanship are still fine!
Even though he played injured, he still gained a lot. Yesterday was an accident.
The news that the eldest son of the Qin family broke his eggs twice and was completely hopeless has spread today. Sun Liuju couldn't help but have a thought when he was counting...could this matter have something to do with the boy from yesterday?
Suddenly feeling a little cold behind his back, Sun Liu shrank his neck. He must have been overthinking it. That kid was just a bit powerful at best. It was OK to bully him. How could he cause such a commotion?
"Have you gained a lot?" A voice sounded from behind.
Sun Liu stared at the white money in his palm, threw the money bag into the ditch, and subconsciously said: "It's not bad..."
Whoosh——
He ran away without looking back.
Snap——
A stone hit his calf. Sun Liu screamed and threw himself on the street. He turned around and kowtowed desperately, "Master, please forgive me! I have an eighty-year-old mother above me and a child who is waiting to be fed. This is the first time I have done this!"
As the footsteps approached, a joking voice sounded, "Yesterday, you seemed to have said the same thing."
The crying stopped abruptly. Sun Liu wiped his nose and tears, and when he saw the person in front of him clearly, he suddenly looked like he had eaten shit.
"Uncle... it's... it's you... uh... I just picked up a money bag. I'll give you this money as a... filial piety."
Luo Guan didn't speak.
"Ahem...I'll leave it here for you...Then, I will continue to listen to what you said yesterday...get out of here..." Sun Liu lay on the ground and curled himself up into a ball.
Luo Guan said calmly: "Have you heard about the Qin family's affairs? Oh, you can tell by the look on his face. If you don't want to become like Young Master Qin, just obediently help me do something."
Sun Liu was so frightened that he almost cried. The information revealed in this sentence was really terrifying. The eldest son of the Qin family was actually his waste! Knowing such a fatal thing, how could he have a good ending? Immediately his face turned pale, and he twitched and looked about to pass.
Luo Guan sneered, "If you dare to pretend to be faint, I will make you unable to sleep!"
Sun Liu got up with a "swish" and said with a sad face, "Master... no, dear father, what on earth do you want to do? I am just a bad guy from the dock, have you treated me like a fart?"
Luo Guan said calmly: "If you do things well, your life will still be yours."
Sun Liu's expression was gloomy and he gritted his teeth, "Okay, I'll listen to you!"
Luo Guan smiled slightly, "You know where you can buy gunpowder in the city, right?"
Sun Liu, a scumbag who lives at the bottom of society, has contacts in various ways. In a low-rise slum before dark, Luo Guan saw with his own eyes an old man lying on the bed, his body stinking and covered with sores. He pulled out a wooden box from under the bed, muttering.
"Five hundred taels of gold, not even half a penny less!"
Gunpowder has appeared long ago, but the formula has always been controlled by the imperial court. It is strictly forbidden to flow into the private sector. Once discovered, it will be confiscated immediately and severely punished! Therefore, except for wars, it can basically only be seen in the mines. This secret organization can actually produce so much, which shows that it is very knowledgeable.
Luo Guan paid the money and came out of the house with the box. He could clearly feel the greedy and sinister looks around him.
Sun Liuzhan trembled and followed closely behind Luo Guan. After making many twists and turns, he walked out of this slum. He let out a sigh of relief and his clothes were soaked with cold sweat.
"Uncle, the matter is done, shall I go?"
Luo Guan said calmly: "One more thing, tell me where are the blood banks of Blackstone and Donghai?
"You are holding explosives in one hand and asking such things in a calm tone. I am really stressed!"
Sun Liu's Adam's apple rolled up and down, he swallowed hard and said two addresses.
Bang——
His vision went dark and he was knocked unconscious.
Luo Guan mentioned Sun Liu and threw him into the corner. By the time this guy woke up, he should have left Shanhe City.
Carrying the wooden box, Luo Guan walked calmly into the long street and disappeared into the flow of people.
…
AlthoughAnyone with enough status and weight in Shanhe City knows that the two rival chambers of commerce, Blackstone and Donghai, which compete for the blood of ferocious beasts, are actually the property of the Qin family, but there are still some honorable projects that should be done to leave a decent fig leaf for the money-loving city lord, so the blood banks of the two chambers of commerce are located in the east of the city and the west of the city.
Tonight there are dense clouds and the air is a bit humid. It seems like it is going to rain. The moon and stars are all covered, making it impossible to see even one's fingers.
Xicheng.
The Blackstone Chamber of Commerce Blood Bank is heavily guarded!
"Everyone should cheer up and keep to their posts. Even if a fly flaps its wings, you have to find it!"
A little boss was drinking in the dark. He didn't know why, but tonight many masters suddenly came to the blood bank. Although the boss ordered everything to remain the same, he couldn't help but feel nervous.
Because of the young master's affairs, the head of the family has killed seven or eight people today with a stick. The little boss doesn't want to be the next one.
Suddenly, a gust of wind blew by, rustling the branches and leaves. The little boss was startled and turned around suddenly but saw nothing.
